title: Oscillatory replacement

mathematical_result.statement: There are strict-N3 target-valid matrices with an invertible indefinite physical pair B and a pre-Schur rank-two original-coordinate bicore of singular product sigma^2>=1 whose exact post-pair Schur cross block is identically zero. For the explicit flat-frame family, conditioning the pair exposes a diffuse rank-four leaf block and current Fresnel-Brascamp-Lieb gives ||p_Q||_infinity<=8/sigma.

construction.matrix: A=[[eps H0,cU^T,cH0V^T],[cU,0,sigma UV^T],[cVH0,sigma VU^T,0]], H0=[[0,1],[1,0]], c^2=sigma eps
construction.strict_N3: For sigma=1 choose eps^2<tau, eps/m<tau, 4/m^2<tau; all diagonals vanish and all physical 2x2 principal determinants are <tau in modulus.

required_newest_source_application.application: Condition the physical pair. The leaf block has rank four, eigenvalues +sigma,+sigma,-sigma,-sigma, and physical row leverage 2/m. Rank-r Theorem F yields |phi(t)|<=min(1,(4pi)^2 sigma^-2 |t|^-2) and ||p_Q||_infinity<=8/sigma. On the natural pair-split cut, Z3=Z5=0.

partner_result_applied.application: For disjoint flat unit banks, Q=2(a^TX_I)(b^TX_J)+(z^TX_D)^2 has kappa=rho=1 and nonzero spectrum {-1,1,1}; the p=3 theorem gives ||p_Q||_infinity<=12 and the family is strict N3 as the bank size grows.

related_prior_result.relationship: Earlier family showed rank2-to-rank1 loss; r41 strengthens to rank2-to-zero and supplies a pre-Schur F exit.

next_step: Prove an exhaustive strict-N3 routing that tests/spends diffuse pre-Schur spectral currency before pair elimination, or else produces a valid post-Schur rank-two packet, rank-one bilinear plus source-disjoint square, volume/hub/ridge/grouped-square/exact-null exit. The hard survivor is destructive overlap plus high-leverage/non-Fresnel pre-Schur geometry with no independent third-curvature packet.
